name: ServiceQ
description: ContextQ, ServerQ and TaskQ v1. Select a recent time range; absence is unknown. Heartbeats are samples, not unique agents. Compression coverage is partial; no token savings claimed.

widgets.name: ServiceQ / Service health signals
widgets.description: Heartbeat samples by service and severity. WARNING also includes unknown; inspect reason. Missing or stale samples are unknown, never healthy.

widgets.name: ServiceQ / Errors and warnings
widgets.description: All observed agent and monitor errors/warnings in the selected period; missing telemetry is not evidence of health.

widgets.name: ServiceQ / Incidents
widgets.description: Deduplicated local ContextQ incidents. Not a total count of affected agent turns.

widgets.name: ServiceQ / Compression observations
widgets.description: Observed compression calls only. Does not establish total Codex WebSocket coverage or model-token savings.

widgets.name: ServiceQ / Queue age
widgets.description: Maximum telemetry outbox age in seconds in the selected period, grouped by service/agent score name.

widgets.name: ServiceQ / Agent activity
widgets.description: Observation counts by name. Proxy heartbeat is not agent liveness. Use trace tags to filter host, agent, device and user.
